entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: A skaberen and stitcher who builds skaab armies, Gisa's rival brother; he secretly sends skaabs to free her and seeks Ludevic's mentorship.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: A necromancer ghoulcaller, Geralf's sister, who escapes prison, befriends Nahiri and raises ghouls to build a monument.

entities.name: Ludevic of Ulm
entities.description: A renowned mage and alchemist whom Geralf admired as a child, who agrees to take Geralf under his wing.

entities.name: Executive Officer Grete
entities.description: An officer who commanded the guard on Gisa's prison caravan and pursues her to Nephalia.

entities.name: Commander Odric
entities.description: The commander to whom Grete reports, who ordered Gisa be imprisoned and muzzled.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A sword-wielding woman who slays Gisa's ghouls, befriends her and has her ghouls build a stone monument.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer whom Geralf mentions and who took Mikaeus's body in Thraben.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: The lunarch whose body Liliana took in Thraben.

entities.name: Gretchen Cecani
entities.description: Geralf and Gisa's late mother, a talented necromancer whom Gisa raised from the dead.

entities.name: Delia Davison
entities.description: A practitioner whose methods for brain extraction Geralf asks Ludevic about.

entities.name: Spot
entities.description: A pet of Geralf's, of which only part remains.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The holy city that Geralf and Gisa besieged with their undead armies.

entities.name: Trostad
entities.description: The place where Geralf's laboratory lies in ruins.

entities.name: Rider's Lock
entities.description: The prison from which Gisa was being transported.

entities.name: Merwald Downs
entities.description: A place where Grete takes shelter.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: The region of Innistrad where the Cecani family home stands and where Gisa raises ghouls on the coast.

entities.name: Cecani Family Home
entities.description: The ruined family house in Nephalia, scarred by a fire, where Gisa hides.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: A region of Innistrad where the caravan was ambushed.

entities.name: Gisa and Nahiri's Monument
aliases: odd structure being built off the coast
entities.description: A stone monument off the Nephalian coast built by Gisa's ghouls at Nahiri's request.

entities.name: Skaabs
entities.description: Shambling stitched-together corpses created by Geralf, used as bodyguards, couriers and an attack force.

entities.name: Ghouls
entities.description: Undead raised by Gisa's whistled song that walk calmly toward her.

events.summary: Geralf writes to Ludevic of Ulm, seeking a mentor in necromantic fabrication after his escape from Thraben to his laboratory in Trostad.
events.quote: I am in need of a mentor

events.summary: Grete's prison caravan carrying Gisa is attacked by misshapen skaabs and Gisa escapes in the chaos.
events.quote: we were overcome by a sudden attack of ghastly, violent, misshapen skaabs.

events.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she has broken out of prison.
events.quote: GUESS WHO JUST BROKE OUT OF PRISON!

events.summary: Gisa describes escaping her carriage and returning to the old family home in Nephalia.
events.quote: I swept my feet over my chains and rammed the door, escaping into the fog

events.summary: Gisa raises her dead parents to apologize for the fire that destroyed the house.
events.quote: I raised Mummy and Father to apologize for what we did to the house.

events.summary: Geralf scolds Gisa for raising their parents and tells her not to contact him again.
Ludevic offers to take Geralf under his wing, sending alchemical texts.
events.quote: If you are amenable, I am more than happy to take you under my proverbial wing.

events.summary: Geralf thanks Ludevic but declares he is sick of games.
events.quote: I am absolutely sick of games.

events.summary: Grete tracks Gisa to the remains of an old manor in Nephalia.
events.quote: I have caught up with Gisa in Nephalia.

events.summary: Grete observes ghouls calmly walking toward Gisa's whistled summons along the Nephalian coast.
events.quote: They simply walk toward their conductor.

events.summary: Gisa meets Nahiri, who cuts down her summoned ghouls and then becomes her friend.
events.quote: the woman unsheathed a tremendous sword and severed each of my ghouls on the spot.

events.summary: Geralf says Liliana took Mikaeus's body in Thraben and left.
events.quote: She took Mikaeus's body back in Thraben and absconded.

events.summary: Odric orders Grete to withdraw because too many undead and a strange structure are on the coast.
Gisa raises an army of ghoul builders for Nahiri to construct a stone monument.
events.quote: My new friend asked for an army of builders, and I have raised her one!

events.summary: Geralf reveals he sent the skaabs to free Gisa from the prison caravan.
events.quote: I was the one who sent the skaabs to free you from the prison caravan.

events.summary: Grete withdraws toward Thraben as Gisa erupts in a violent rage.
Gisa rejects Geralf's help, boasts of her legacy with Nahiri and sends their dead mother to deliver her letter.
events.quote: I hope you don't mind I sent Mummy to deliver it to you.

relations.note: Rival necromancers, though Geralf secretly helped her.
Offers to take Geralf under his wing.
relations.quote: I am more than happy to take you under my proverbial wing.
Any son of Gretchen Cecani is a son of mine.

relations.note: He has made his name creating them.
relations.quote: the very creatures I have made my name creating

relations.note: She acts on his orders and reports to him.
relations.quote: as per your orders I tripled the guard that would travel along with the caravan.

relations.note: Gisa regards Nahiri as her first friend and builds her monument.
relations.quote: The woman introduced herself as Nahiri, and she is clever and quite interested in my work.

relations.note: She took his body in Thraben.
relations.quote: She took Mikaeus's body back in Thraben and absconded.
